jsonshape 1: report.versioned

type Report struct
	"failed" bool
	"findings" []github.com/dexpace/morphic/engine/triage.Finding
	"sources" []github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.SourceInfo
	"unusedRules" []github.com/dexpace/morphic/engine/triage.Rule
	"warnings" []string

type encoding/json/jsontext.Pointer string

type github.com/dexpace/morphic/engine/triage.Finding struct
	"accepted" bool omitzero
	"diagnostic" github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Diagnostic
	"rule" *github.com/dexpace/morphic/engine/triage.Rule omitzero
	"severity" github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Severity

type github.com/dexpace/morphic/engine/triage.Rule struct
	"accept" bool omitzero
	"code" string
	"node" string omitempty
	"pointer" encoding/json/jsontext.Pointer omitempty
	"reason" string
	"severity" github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Severity omitempty

type github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Diagnostic struct
	"code" string
	"message" string
	"provenance" github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Provenance
	"severity" github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Severity

type github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Inferred string

type github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Position struct
	"column" int omitzero
	"line" int

type github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Provenance struct
	"inferred" github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Inferred omitempty
	"node" string omitempty
	"pointer" encoding/json/jsontext.Pointer omitempty
	"position" github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Position omitzero
	"source" int
	"writtenBy" int omitzero

type github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.Severity string
	const "error"
	const "info"
	const "warning"

type github.com/dexpace/morphic/ir.SourceInfo struct
	"format" string
	"hash" string
	"path" string
	"selfURI" string omitempty

type versioned struct
	embed Report
	"version" int
